verdict_raw:
**Not clean — 3 QA issues, all in/near the Share modal:**

1. **[High] Contradictory QR error messaging** — The QR box says "Design too large for QR" (QR impossible), but the red caption below says "Design is large – QR **may be hard to scan**" (QR possible but risky). Two different failure states shown at once. Pick one; if QR can't render, replace the box content with a clear "QR unavailable" state and update the modal intro ("Scan the QR code or copy the link…") to match.

2. **[Medium] Dangling instruction** — The caption says "Use the link **or Save** instead," but there is no Save button in the modal (only Copy Link / Close). Remove "Save" or add the control it references.

3. **[Low] Non-shareable link** — The copy field contains `http://localhost:8191/...`, which won't work for anyone else. Fine in dev, but verify a public URL is generated in production before this ships.

**Minor / cosmetic:**
- Left sidebar: "Patios & Paths" section header is clipped exactly at the status-bar edge — acceptable if the list scrolls, but looks cut off; consider bottom padding or a fade.
- Modal hides the view controls but doesn't dim the canvas behind it — a subtle scrim would make the dialog state more obvious.

Rest of the screen (top toolbar, asset library, floating tool panel, bottom toolbar, status bar, compass/zoom widgets) is well laid out with no overlaps — a new user would grasp "share my design" in under 5 seconds once the QR messaging is made consistent.
ctx: share modal: QR code canvas, share URL box, Copy Link + Close
